newsitem.title: UK: Albright & Wilson year results seen in line.
newsitem.headline: Albright & Wilson year results seen in line.

text.p: Albright & Wilson Plc, the UK chemicals group, said on Wednesday that its full year results should be in line with market expectations.
The comment was made in a company trading statement which also said that progress in speciality chemicals continued.

The surfactants unit has shown "steady recovery of profitability" which is continuing in the second half, with sales volumes and margins holding steady. But the phosphates unit continues to suffer tough competition in the Americas.

The group reported that one of its major customers in that division A&W Troy in Mexico has said it plans to end purchases of phopheric acid from the group. The 1996 impact will be limited but there will be "some short term impact on profits" in 1997.
The effect of sterling's recent strength on group results is reported to be limited so far, but the company says it will remain an issue to be taken into account during 1997.
Albright & Wilson will report its year results for the year to December 31 sometime in March 1997.
